verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is a set of software libraries and tools published on GitHub, and its official docs give Ubuntu deb install paths. These are the ROS-Base bare-bones install and the Desktop install, followed by a step that verifies the C++ and Python APIs work locally, so users run the whole core on their own machines. Community users report dependency hell and a convoluted build system, which makes self-hosting harder but does not contradict it. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement in the evidence, and independent corroboration that installation and deployment go smoothly.
